items.item_text: FinOps Certified Practitioner, PMP, or related certification
Bachelor’s degree in a related area and/or equivalent experience/training
Master’s degree in a related discipline
Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional technology programs and projects, including scope, schedule, budget, risk, stakeholder management, system integration, and vendor management
Experience in healthcare, higher education, research, or grant-funded environments
Experience with Apptio Cloudability or a comparable cloud cost management platform
Experience designing cost attribution models and directing cross-platform reporting or data integration initiatives

UCLA Health is seeking a hands-on FinOps Program Manager to lead our enterprise cloud financial management (FinOps) program across public cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), AI, and data platforms. You will set the strategy and roadmap, lead the projects that deliver it, and lead a cross-functional governance workgroup that recommends policy and standards. Where commercial tooling (currently Apptio Cloudability) falls short, you will direct analytics, automation, and integrations with engineering partners.

The role works across a complex funding landscape of research grants, state allotments, and internal chargebacks. You will provide the budgeting process, data, and recommendations; budget approval and spending decisions remain with designated budget owners. This is an individual-contributor role with no direct reports.
Direct FinOps projects with defined scope, plans, schedules, and risk management, leading cross-functional teams from engineering, finance, and research through delivery and handoff to operations
Develop FinOps strategy, proposed policies, and standards, and obtain approval through established governance processes
Lead cloud cost allocation, showback, and chargeback, mapping consumption to applications, departments, and funding sources such as grants
Run the cloud budgeting and forecasting process with budget owners: track spend against each owner’s budget, report budget vs. actual, and flag variances early
Manage implementation and enhancement of FinOps tooling (Apptio Cloudability), including reporting, integrations, tagging compliance, and anomaly detection
Identify and track optimization opportunities, cost savings, and cost avoidance, and provide analysis for cloud commitments in partnership with finance and procurement
Lead cost visibility and allocation for AI consumption (token-based services), Databricks, GPU, and research computing
Report program KPIs, progress, and risks to executive leadership, and lead a cross-functional FinOps community of practice
Salary offers are based on a variety of factors. The University anticipates offering a salary between $140,000 - $160,000 depending on experience, qualifications, and internal equity.
Data visualization (Power BI, Tableau)
Advanced knowledge of cloud financial management (FinOps): cost allocation, showback/chargeback, budgeting, forecasting, and optimization
Working knowledge of scripting (such as Python), SQL, APIs, or automation
Expert knowledge of AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud billing and cost data, with the ability to turn large datasets into clear reporting
Databricks and AI platform billing; familiarity with Technology Business Management (TBM)
Demonstrated ability to communicate with executive-level management on a regular basis
Proven ability to build consensus and lead cross-functional work without direct authority
